attributes.name: Ishtoreth
attributes.powers:
Damage dealt by Ishtoreth is dealt to each character at your location.

Before you act, examine the top card of you deck. If it has the Attack trait or is a weapon, bury it; otherwise, discard it. A random character at another location summons and encounters the henchman Gholdako.
